Name: Semillon Wine
definition: Semillon wine is a white wine varietal produced only from Semillon grapes.  The primary fruit flavors in Semillon wine are lemon, apple, pear and green papaya. Semillon is France’s 3rd most planted white wine variety behind Sauvignon Blanc and Chardonnay.

Name: Mille-Feuille Pastry
definition: A French pastry traditionally made up of three layers of puff pastry (pâte feuilletée), alternating with two layers of pastry cream (crème pâtissière). The top pastry layer is dusted with confectioner's sugar, and sometimes cocoa, pastry crumbs, or pulverized seeds (e.g. roasted almonds) or is glazed with icing or fondant in alternating white (icing) and brown (chocolate) stripes, and combed.
